v1_human_g2_ac.ac_1: as there are no existing events when a valid duration meeting is requested and possible, the function returns all possible slots
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_2: when given an event calendar a slot that starts at a time and ends v1_human an event starts, overlapping is to be avoided
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_3: when meetings over lunch break (12:00 - 13:00) when meeting is requested, those slot slots with a lunch break are excluded
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_4: given overlapping events group each other when slots are calculated, the overlapping events are treated as single blocked time

v1_human_g2_constraints.c_1: meetings slots are generated every 30 min.
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_4: meetings must start of day is limited to ascending time order

v1_human_g2_goal: the objective of the system is to provide slot suggest meeting times when given a day and a desired meeting duration without conflicts
v1_human_g2_input: events, type: list of dictionaries format: [{"start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"}, ...] each event blocks time. during which meeting can't be scheduled. valid values: times must be in 24 hr format, and times must be valid
v1_human_g2_output: function returns list of starting suggested valid time slots representing start time in HH:MM format without conflicts
